user.title: Set up Ilumi
user.description: All your bulbs share one network key. A number is suggested, keep it. Only if bulbs were already set up with a key before, enter that key here. After this, use "Add bulb" on the Ilumi entry for each bulb.

error.invalid_key: The network key must be a whole number between 0 and 4294967295.
error.key_zero: Key 0 cannot be used. Choose another number.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Ilumi is already set up. Add bulbs with "Add bulb" on its entry.

user.title: Add Ilumi bulb
user.description: These bulbs were found nearby. Reset a new bulb first (switch it off and on five times, it runs red, green, blue, white). The closest bulb has the strongest signal.

details.title: Set up the bulb
details.description: Name the bulb and pick its shape. Keep "Set up the bulb now" ticked for a reset bulb. Untick it only for a bulb that already has the network key of this entry.

manual.title: Add Ilumi bulb by address
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth address. Keep "Set up the bulb now" ticked for a reset bulb. Untick it only for a bulb that already has the network key of this entry.

confirm.title: Is this the bulb?
confirm.description: The bulb you picked should light up magenta now. If a different bulb lights up, or none does, untick the box to go back to the list. A bulb that does not light up may not have been reset.

error.invalid_address: Not a valid Bluetooth address, expected something like E1:71:DA:73:0A:E1.
error.cannot_connect: The bulb could not be reached. Move it closer to a Bluetooth adapter or proxy and try again.

abort.already_configured: This bulb is already set up.
